The '''Arapia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Dalchon sector/Legends|Dalchon sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arapia]], homeworld of the [[Kadri'Ra]].
